Improved:


- Sunny and MCP are now fully available; no more "Beta" badges. (Voice mode is still labeled experimental since it's flakier than chat.)
- Task automations now fire when using Claude Desktop or other MCP-connected AI assistants; completing or rescheduling a task through MCP now properly syncs with Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Trello, and Gmail.


Fixed:


- Trello panel no longer crashes with an error screen; resolved a bug where a failed request to Trello could corrupt the task list and crash the panel.
- Desktop app: fixed a 5–7 second stall returning from Settings; going back to your workspace after Settings on Mac or Windows no longer freezes.
- AI assistants now report the correct task category; fixed a bug where tasks in nested channels showed the wrong personal/work classification when read through MCP.
- [Monday.com](http://monday.com/) integration no longer hangs for accounts with lots of boards; fixed a bug that could make the board list take nearly a minute to load, or fail outright, for accounts that hadn't finished picking their boards yet.
